productivebeesgenesis.configuration.bala: These rules apply directly only when the global balance profile is Custom.
Open the balance profile list. Switching profiles never removes installed upgrades.

Productivity and speed tiers are mutually exclusive. Centrifuge productivity upgrades add parallel processing only. Apiaries obey bee behavior and weather-tolerance genes. Default Productive Bees and centrifuge stack limits are 4 and 8. Closer to the original feel of Mekanism and Productive Bees, but still far from the true power of the Myriad Creations Bee.

Productivity and speed tiers can coexist. Centrifuge productivity upgrades increase both output and parallel processing. Apiaries ignore bee behavior and weather-tolerance genes as in earlier versions. Default Productive Bees and centrifuge stack limits are 8 and 16. Blessed by the Myriad Creations Bee, the Productive Bees upgrades reclaim part of their rightful power.
Use the individual rules and limits below. Switching from Basic or Paradox Infinity inherits the previously effective settings.
Prevent alpha, beta, gamma, and omega productivity upgrades from coexisting in one machine.
Prevent TIME and TIME_2 upgrades from coexisting in one machine.
Also multiply centrifuge output quantity. Productive Bees parallel processing remains active when disabled.
Pause each bee when its behavior or weather-tolerance gene does not permit work under the current time and weather.
